description: List the BORME events (registry acts) of a company for one calendar year, paginated: date, section, province, act type (Nombramientos, Ceses, Ampliación de capital, Disolución...) and the act text. Defaults to the current year, 20 per page; check `total` and `pages` and use `year` to walk back through the history (data from 2009).

slug.description: Company slug, e.g. "telefonica-de-espana-sa". Get it from borme_search_companies (field `slug`).

year.description: Calendar year to list (1900 up to the current year). Defaults to the current year.

name: borme_get_company_events
